questions.q: Which port does PX4 expect a companion on by default?
questions.explain: TELEM1 is for the GCS, TELEM2 for the companion.

questions.q: Which parameters enable MAVLink for a companion on TELEM2?
questions.explain: Onboard mode is the message set for an onboard computer.

questions.q: Can you run MAVLink and uXRCE-DDS on the same port?
options: Yes, if the baud rate is 921600

questions.q: The recommended TELEM2 baud rate for a companion?
questions.explain: SER_TEL2_BAUD = 921600 for a short wire and a heavy data stream.

questions.q: What should happen when the companion fails?
questions.explain: The boundary of responsibility: the FC flies on its own.

questions.q: Why add the Jetson user to the dialout group?
options: Access to the UART without sudo
For access to CUDA and the GPU
questions.explain: Otherwise the serial port is not accessible to a regular user.

questions.q: How do you reliably find out which /dev/ttyTHS* corresponds to pins 8/10 on your JetPack version?
options: Take the name from any article
With a loopback: a jumper on 8–10 and an echo test
By the first port in ls /dev
questions.explain: The name depends on the board and JetPack (ttyTHS0 or ttyTHS1); the echo through the jumper only comes back from the right port.

questions.q: Can MAVLink and uXRCE-DDS share one TELEM2?
options: Only over USB, not over UART
questions.explain: MAV_1_CONFIG and UXRCE_DDS_CFG on different ports.
